{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# This ensures one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction: mean of 'responded'
response_fraction = df_treatment['responded'].mean()

print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {len(df_treatment)}")
print(f"Response fraction: {response_fraction}")"}
